observations: Photo 0: a cream or off-white fabric sofa with a rounded tub-style back and arms in one continuous curve and a single bench seat cushion, sized for two people.
Photo 0: upholstery looks like a soft suede-like fabric; surface looks clean from this angle, with mild shading on the back and arms.
Photo 1: closer view along the seat and back; a few faint darker marks on the inner back and light grubbiness near the arm seam; seams look intact.
Neither photo shows the legs, underside, rear or whether the cushion is removable.
No brand label is visible; watermark 'GREGEZE97' and 'POSTED ON' text on both photos.

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show no tears and a fairly clean surface, but faint marks on the back in photo 1, and the rear, base and legs are not shown; light upholstery hides stains poorly in warm light.
Photo 0 shows a sofa with a single bench cushion sized for two.

risks.risk: Stains, discoloration or wear on cream fabric not visible under the warm indoor light.
risks.proof: Daylight photos of the seat, back and arms close up.

risks.risk: Sagging seat, broken frame or loose joints.
risks.proof: Clip of someone sitting down and getting up, and pressing the seat and back.
risks.if_unproven: as worn seat with soft support

risks.risk: Damaged or missing legs, torn underside, or damage on the back side against the wall.
risks.proof: Photo of the sofa pulled out from the wall showing the rear and the underside with the legs.
risks.if_unproven: as needing leg or base repair

risks.risk: Odour, bed bugs or pests in the fabric.
risks.proof: Close photos of the seams and crevices under the seat cushion edge.

proof_requests: Daylight photos of the seat, back and arms close up.
Photo of the rear and underside with the legs.
Clip of someone sitting on it.
Rough measurements of length, depth and height.
response.reason: Photos 0 and 1 show a cream fabric 2 seater sofa, identified by type, in fair visible condition, so it can be priced at its worst case as a used 2 seater needing cleaning until daylight close-ups and a view of the base and legs support 'very neat'.
